key_information_units.information: Net profit decreased to €28.7 million (11% YoY decline) with return on equity falling to 12.9% (from 16.2%) and cost-to-income ratio rising to 52.3% (from 49.6%).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report attributes decline to lower-interest environment; Financial Results table confirms net profit, ROE, and cost-to-income ratios for 2025 and 2024.

key_information_units.information: Loan portfolio grew by €340 million (+19%) to €2.11 billion.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report states loan portfolio growth of €340 million (+19%) to exceed €2 billion for the first time; Note 11 provides loan portfolio figures.

key_information_units.information: Customer base increased by 19,000 (+9%) to 227,000 clients; deposits grew by €170 million (+9%) to €2.05 billion.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report details customer growth (19,000 +9% to 227,000) and deposit growth (€170 million +9% to €2.05 billion); Note 15 confirms deposit balances.

key_information_units.information: Profitability pressure from declining interest rates reduced net interest income to €73.3 million (from €77.6 million) and net interest margin to 3.0% (from 3.8%).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report cites lower-interest environment impact; Financial Results table provides net interest income and NIM for 2025 and 2024.

key_information_units.information: First tranche of €250 million covered bonds issued.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report (page 10) announces first tranche of €250 million covered bonds issued on Irish Stock Exchange as part of €750 million programme.

key_information_units.information: €249 million EIB Group guarantee agreement for new loans.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report (page 10) details guarantee agreement transferring credit risk to EIB Group, enabling up to €249 million in new loans for sustainable projects.

key_information_units.information: €5 million unsecured subordinated loan from European Energy Efficiency Fund.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report (page 10) notes loan agreement with European Energy Efficiency Fund for €5 million to finance energy efficiency projects.

key_information_units.information: CET1 ratio at 14.15%, Tier 1 ratio at 16.11%, and total capital ratio at 18.54%, all above regulatory requirements.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Capitalisation and risk positions table shows capital ratios exceeding minimum requirements (Core Tier 1: 4.5%, Tier 1: 6.0%, Total capital: 8.0%).

key_information_units.information: Credit portfolio quality remained low-risk with credit loss allowance of €3.3 million; non-performing loans represented minimal proportion of the portfolio with strong collateral coverage.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 2 (credit risk management and ECL models) and Note 11 (loan allowances and stage classification) confirm low-risk profile and collateral coverage.

key_information_units.information: Sustainability initiatives include LEED Platinum head office, paperless operations, IT equipment recycling program, and financing of renewable energy projects totaling 81.3 MW capacity.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Sustainability Report details LEED Platinum certification, paperless adoption, device recycling (173 devices in 2025), and renewable energy financing reaching 81.3 MW.

key_information_units.information: Dividend payment of €0.07 per share (€7.2 million) distributed from 2024 pre-tax profit, consistent with 25% payout policy.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Dividend Policy section confirms €0.07 per share payment (€7.2 million) from 2024 pre-tax profit, maintaining 25% payout ratio.

key_information_units.information: Alvar Pihlapuu appointed to Management Board in January 2026.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 26 (Events after balance sheet date) records Supervisory Board appointment of Alvar Pihlapuu to Management Board on 21 January 2026.
